DS.sections_used: T4.1/T4.2 operating conditions (VCC 1.14-1.26V, VCCPLL 1.14-1.26V, VCCIO 1.20-3.46V, VPP_2V5 2.30-3.46V master-SPI/NVCM, 2.30-3.00 while programming NVCM); 4.4 POR monitors (VCC, SPI_VCCIO1, VPP_2V5); 4.5 power-up sequence (VCC,VCCPLL first, then SPI_VCCIO1, then VPP_2V5; others any time after 0.5V); 4.6 CRESET_B external reset; T4.24 sysCONFIG (tCRESET_B>=200ns, tCR_SCK typ 1200us, master-SPI MCLK low 7-17/typ 12 MHz); NVCM one-time; config = NVCM or Master-SPI external flash or Slave SPI; SG48 paddle must connect GND

TN02001.note: boot source: on POR/CRESET_B rising, SPI_SS sampled - HIGH: configure from NVCM if programmed, else SPI Master from external flash; LOW: slave-SPI wait. CRESET_B is a pure input with NO internal pull-up (10K pull-up required if undriven); 49 config clock cycles after CDONE before PIOs activate

TN02006.note: filter groups: VCC = 4.7uF + 100nF/pin; SPI_VCC = 4.7uF + 100nF/pin; VCCPLL = 100ohm + 4.7uF + 100nF; VCCPLL tied to VCC when PLL unused (external filter still required)

pull_capability: iCE40 pads have internal pull-UP only -> the four rev-A pull-DOWN inputs (T_data, L_data, B_latch, R_latch) and the 12 key pull-downs need external 10K resistors (BOM delta +16 vs GW1NZ)

config_decision.why: NVCM is one-time-programmable and its OPEN programming flow is unverified in the installed tools (fpga workstream); an external SOIC-8 flash is reprogrammable via in-circuit SPI with the FPGA held in CRESET_B (io tri-stated per DS 4.6)
config_decision.boot: SPI_SS pin 16 sampled HIGH at boot (flash CS# pull-up on board) + blank/deselected NVCM -> Master SPI power-up from external flash (TN02001 sec.3.1)

core.source: LDO from VCC 3.3V backplane rail; VCCPLL ties to VCC1V2 through 100ohm+4.7uF+100nF
